entries.text: 4. A Levite and chorister in the tabernacle services 1Ch 15:18,21; 16:5
5. A Levite, ancestor of Jehaziel, who encouraged Judah against their enemies 2Ch 20:14
6. A scribe during the reign of Uzziah 2Ch 26:11
7. A Levite who cleansed the temple 2Ch 29:13
8. A chief of the Levites who gave, with other chiefs, five-thousand five-hundred “small cattle” for sacrifice 2Ch 35:9
9. A son of Adonikam, an exile who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra Ezr 8:13
10. A priest who was defiled by marriage to an idolatrous woman Ezr 10:43
